title: Set Spell Check Language (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Set Spell Check Language applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Set Spell Check Language (BtnSpellCheck) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Proofing-language scope application (selection incl. cells/groups, presentation) pinned on a real host
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host the production ProofingLanguageService applies German to a French pre-set fixture: the selection scope changes exactly seven ranges (one text shape, four table cells, two group children) and leaves slide 2's French shape untouched; the presentation scope then sweeps the whole deck (27 changes including masters/layouts) and switches slide 2 to German. The run reports execution and writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry.
